9be9cc96356ef01a.description:
What is Finary?
Money is broken: most people’s wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see. We are putting a private banker in everyone’s pocket, with the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client. Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us. Finary AI turns that context into a plan, and our investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real.
Why now?
AI makes this possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy: years of per-user financial data that no public dataset holds, a brand that brings in half of our new users through our own channels, and licences (PSAN, Investment Firm, MiCA) we secured before they became mandatory. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest. Founders and leaders from Qonto, Photoroom, Bitpanda, UBS and Wise also invested.
What we offer
We’re 70 builders with real ownership from day 1, tier-1 salary and equity, and offices in central Paris with hybrid remote. Our culture is direct and built on radical candor. AI is a real bar here: everyone has rebuilt how they work around it. Read more about our values here.
The opportunity
More than 1M people track and grow their wealth with Finary. In 2021, when a simple registration was enough to offer crypto in France, we chose to build fully regulated. Today Finary is a crypto-asset service provider under MiCA, an investment firm, a payment institution and an insurance broker. Very few European platforms hold that combination.
Our compliance team is organised by role, not by product: compliance officer, AML, senior advisory and control. Each role covers every licence. Reporting to our Head of Compliance, who is our AML/CFT officer, you'll work alongside our AML analyst and take ownership of the framework that protects our clients and our licences, with most of our exposure in crypto.

What you'll do
• 
Lead the AML/CFT framework: procedures, client risk classification, detection rules and tools (screening, blockchain analytics, Travel Rule), calibrated on our own data.
• 
Investigate and decide the hard cases: enhanced reviews of individuals and companies (ownership chains, financial statements, flows), on-chain investigations, decisions on suspicion.
• 
Draft and file suspicious transaction reports, and act as deputy TRACFIN declarant and correspondent.
• 
Handle screening and asset freezing: PEP, sanctions and adverse media hits, list updates.
• 
Build with AI: design and tune the agents and rules in our back-office tool that prepare files and clear first-level reviews, and keep the decision on suspicion human.
• 
Work with Ops, Care, Product and our outsourced review team so that AML decisions are clear, fast and fair to the honest majority of our clients.
What we're looking for
• 
You've spent 6 to 8 years in AML/CFT in financial services, including hands-on work at a crypto-asset service provider (PSAN/CASP).
• 
You've drafted and filed suspicious transaction reports with TRACFIN yourself.
• 
You investigate on-chain: you use blockchain analytics tools and you know the Travel Rule and self-hosted wallets.
• 
You hold a certification in on-chain analysis (Chainalysis CCI, CCCA or CRC, or a TRM Labs or Elliptic equivalent) and a Travel Rule certification (Notabene NB-TRFC or equivalent).
• 
You work with data and AI every day: you query data yourself and you already use AI in your reviews or investigations. This is a must, not a plus.
• 
You decide on evidence, you keep weak signals in proportion, and you explain your decisions clearly.
• 
You prioritise a growing queue by risk without missing a legal deadline, and you move the framework forward at the same time.
• 
Fluent French and professional English.
This role is not for you if you'd rather stay on onboarding checks, you prefer advising to deciding, or you need a large financial crime department and mature tools before you can start.
You don't tick every box? Apply anyway if you've done the core of the job: investigating cases, deciding them and filing the reports.
Interviews
Interviews with French-speaking candidates are held in French. As an international company, we expect a working level of English, which we test during the screening call.
Compensation: €65K – €80K • Offers Equity

9b489372b13ff1cd.description:
About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
As a Deployment Strategist Lead, you'll be fully responsible for opening up a new market for ElevenLabs, and building a team to make it happen. This is a senior position in which you’ll operate as if a co-founder, working alongside an experienced sales leader, of an effective startup moving from 0 -> 1 within our broader org, aiming to deploy our voice AI technology at the most Strategic customers in the market against their most challenging problems. All the while you’ll be able to leverage support from the rest of ElevenLabs to accelerate.

You will be responsible for hiring the team you need, winning the first customers in the market and ensuring that our product generates impact for them.

No two days are the same, but you should expect to:
• 
Meet with strategic customers to understand their critical audio and voice AI needs and locate their biggest pain points.
• 
Build and lead a team of forward deployed engineers within the region.
• 
Identify relevant use cases through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Engineers to implement our voice and audio AI technology into innovative solutions.
• 
Design and architect bespoke integrations for customers, ensuring our technology fits seamlessly into their products and operations.
• 
Guide customers on best practices for implementing our voice and audio AI models to maximize their effectiveness.
• 
Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.
• 
Collaborate with our Research and Product teams to incorporate field insights into ElevenLabs' software products and AI models.
• 
Build and deliver compelling demos of our voice and audio AI technology to new and existing customers.
• 
Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.
• 
Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.
• 
Collaborate daily with our customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure optimal implementation of ElevenLabs' technologies.

Requirements
• 
Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Proven experience engaging and influencing C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, both internally and at customer or partner organizations.
• 
People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and manage high-performing technical teams while fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture.
• 
Basic proficiency in Python and understanding of API integration to implement scripts and help with prototyping/demo building.
• 
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical concepts and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.
• 
Technical aptitude to quickly understand our voice and audio AI models and their applications.
• 
Strategic and Commercial Awareness: Ability to align technical strategy with business objectives, with an understanding of deal structures, go-to-market motions, and revenue impact.
• 
Nice to have: Partner Ecosystem Development - Experience identifying, building, and nurturing relationships with system integrators, resellers, and technology partners to drive market growth.
Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in India, with a preference of Bangalore. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.
We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

9b2ed02218c23b19.description:
Filiz est une startup SaaS de 30 personnes qui digitalise aujourd'hui les contrats d'apprentissage en France et construit son deuxième produit : un ERP nouvelle génération pour transformer la façon dont les établissements d'enseignement supérieur opèrent au quotidien.
Depuis 2025, Filiz est accompagnée par Hexa, le startup studio français derrière des succès de licornes comme Spendesk, Aircall et Front.
Nous attaquons un marché immense, encore largement à réinventer. Le premier produit est en production, les clients sont là. Maintenant, nous entrons dans une nouvelle phase : construire un produit ambitieux, sortir de France et bâtir la référence européenne des outils pour l'enseignement supérieur.
Nous cherchons un(e) Senior Software Engineer capable de prendre l'ownership d'un produit, d'une architecture et d'un domaine technique, tout en restant profondément hands-on. Le poste n'a pas de management hiérarchique : ton impact passe par le code, les choix d'architecture et la montée en compétence de l'équipe.
Intégré au sein d’une équipe, tu travailleras principalement sur l'ERP, encore en construction : tu participeras à le concevoir et à l'amener jusqu'à la production. Le produit historique reste en production et l'équipe continue de le faire vivre.

Ce que tu vas faire chez nous
• 
Build & Run de A à Z : tu conçois et fais évoluer des features end-to-end : design, développement, releases et suivi en production.
• 
Hands-on & design : tu codes, refactores et améliores l'existant. Tu participes à l'architecture avec le CTO et poses les bases d'un système capable de scaler.
• 
PR review & excellence technique : tu élèves le niveau de l'équipe en challengeant le code, la modélisation, les cas limites et la maintenabilité.
• 
Intégrations robustes : tu construis des APIs et des systèmes résilients adaptés à des contraintes métier fortes.
• 
Fiabilité & observabilité : tu conçois des systèmes capables de détecter et prévenir les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent les utilisateurs.
• 
Leadership technique : tu accompagnes les développeurs de l'équipe, partages tes pratiques et fais grandir les personnes autour de toi.
Ce qui t'attend techniquement
• 
Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, monorepo Turborepo
• 
Observabilité : Sentry, BetterStack, OpenTelemetry
• 
Façon de travailler : Kanban, sans sprint. On livre en petits incréments et on deploy plusieurs fois par jour

Profil recherché
• 
6+ ans d'expérience avec une expérience prouvée sur des produits en production utilisés par de vrais utilisateurs.
• 
Tu as déjà construit et opéré un backend dans la durée. Tu connais les compromis d'une architecture qui doit tenir dans le temps.
• 
Tu es capable de couvrir tout le cycle : compréhension du produit, system design, développement, déploiement et run.
• 
Tu as le réflexe des cas limites. Quand on manipule des documents légaux et des données dont nos clients dépendent au quotidien, la question « que se passe-t-il si cet appel échoue au milieu ? » compte plus que la maîtrise d'un framework.
• 
Tu sais prendre des décisions avec une information incomplète et les assumer. On cherche quelqu'un qui tranche, pas quelqu'un qui organise une quatrième réunion.
• 
Tu sais avancer dans l'imparfait. La dette technique existe, elle est nommée et priorisée : tu préfères faire progresser le produit plutôt que de viser une perfection théorique.
• 
Tu utilises l'IA au quotidien et tu veux participer à construire nos pratiques et nos outils, pas seulement coder plus vite.
• 
Tu as déjà joué un rôle de Tech Lead : ownership d'un système, décisions d'architecture et accompagnement d'autres développeurs.

Processus de recrutement
• 
Echange RH
• 
Entretien technique avec un développeur de l'équipe
• 
Entretien technique (algorithme et design technique) avec le CTO
• 
Entretien de fit avec deux des fondateurs
• 
Prise de référence et offre

Conditions
• 
Salaire: 50-65 k€ selon expérience
• 
Télétravail: full remote (et des bureaux à Paris si tu en as envie)

Who We Are
Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. 
 
Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role
Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact by developing data scientists, setting clear expectations for them, providing hands-on mentorship, and removing blockers.

You will guide and advise multiple data science projects so that they stay on track and have timely delivery with maximum impact. These projects will involve statistical modeling, experiment design, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization. You'll collaborate cross-functionally to validate direction through data, build trust in organizational tactics and strategy by consulting on experiments, and become an expert in our core metrics like searches, installs, and revenue. You'll also drive improvement of the data pipeline. Because of our strong privacy policies, you'll need to think creatively and develop strategies for how we can surface more actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

As a Director, Data Science, you'll help shape our all-in-one privacy solution and join our mission to show the world that protecting your privacy online can be simple. 

About You
• 
You have 10+ years of experience in data science or ML engineering, with 4+ years leading teams, and a track record of setting multi-team roadmaps and adapting swiftly as priorities shift.
• 
You've driven organizational culture toward data-driven decision-making and can translate technical tradeoffs and risks clearly for executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
• 
You enjoy coaching experienced data scientists who are already highly skilled. You give direct, actionable feedback and you've built teams where people do the best work of their careers.
• 
You can deploy and iterate ML and NLP solutions in production at expert level, with deep knowledge of when to reach for which tools - especially in constrained environments requiring fast responses and strict privacy standards.
• 
You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language and stay close to the technical work when it matters most.
• 
You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid.
• 
You have strong LLM/AI experience including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and AI-assisted development, and can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces using sparse or privacy-constrained data.
• 
Preferred: experience at a consumer-facing tech company where data or analytics is core to the product strategy.

Compensation
This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:
• 
United States: $263,300 USD annually
• 
United Kingdom: £183,850 GBP annually
• 
Canada: C$346,250 CAD annually
• 
Europe/Rest of World: €214,950 EUR annually
In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.
 
Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.
 
Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

Hiring Process
Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing
• 
Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.
• 
While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

About the Role

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. This role is based in the Wisconsin area, reporting to the Regional Director. You will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. By demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation, you will help cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers.

• Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals.

• Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs and contribute to comprehensive account planning.

• Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client businesses and aligning technical solutions with their strategic goals.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving.

• 5+ years of full-cycle sales experience within the software or security industry.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Progressive selling experience engaging with enterprise accounts and selling at the C-Level.

• Residency in or willingness to commute within the greater Wisconsin area. 

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Effectively leverage LLMs and Generative AI tools to boost productivity and sales effectiveness across research, prospecting, customer prep, and opportunity management.

• Established relationships with current and prospective customers and a deep understanding of how technology facilitates high-level business goals.

• Proficiency in strategic sales planning with a proven track record of closing net new logos.

• Experience meeting or exceeding sales targets while leveraging channel partnerships.

Our portfolio includes One Acre Fund, Digital Green, Noora Health, Youth Impact, Jacaranda Health and Living Goods, across India, East Africa and West Africa. Since 2022 we have moved 18 technical professionals from industry into the social sector. Our goal is 50 a year. **The Role** We’re looking for a **Technical Talent Partner** to join our Operations Team. You will bring people who have built products at scale in industry into organizations where their work changes what happens to millions of people. You will hire for our own technical team, and for the organizations we fund, many of whom are hiring their first engineer, product manager, or data lead. We have hired people from Google, Meta, Zepto, Spacelift and Atlas AI. The role exists to keep doing that at scale: moving experienced technical people out of industry and embedding them with highly effective social sector organizations that are ready for change. **What You’ll Do** - **Map the market and find the people.** Know which companies produce the profile we need, what makes them consider a move, and what our pitch has to overcome. Use AI across the whole funnel: mapping talent pools, surfacing non-obvious candidates, drafting outreach, and doing it at scale. - **Screen with judgment.** Work out how much of what an application claims the candidate personally owned. Run a conversation that establishes what they built, which decisions were theirs, and what they would change if they did it again. Candidates know what a job description is asking for and will tell you they have it, so the skill is getting to evidence rather than assertion. - **Partner with hiring managers.** Agree the role definition and the hiring bar. Challenge a role specification that does not describe what the team actually needs. Calibrate your screening against our tech team’s judgment so that one standard applies. While the assessment of technical depth stays with the tech team, you will filter the promising candidates to the tech round. - **Build the referral engine.** Half our hires should come through referrals, and every person we hire should refer someone. Build it into the process, and grow our candidate roster several times over. - **Run the events.** Shape and run events with VCs and technical communities in India, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa and the US. - **Own the compensation conversation.** We do not compete with industry on salary, and most of the people we want have never heard of the organizations we fund. Building the case for this work, and putting it in front of people before they are looking for a job, is a core part of this role. - **Run the process and close.** Communicate promptly and keep candidates moving. Handle counteroffers. Keep people warm between offer and start date. - **Build the playbook.** Track where candidates come from, where they drop, how long each stage takes. Use that to fix what is not working, and document what we learn so the next search starts ahead of the last one. **Who You Are** **Required** - 5+ years recruiting technical roles, at least 2 of them in-house at a product company. - You can hold a conversation with an engineer or product manager about what they built and you know when an answer is thin. - You have designed your own screening questions and you can explain what each one was testing for. - Strong sourcing in Indian technical markets. - You have built something with AI that changed how you work. You can describe what you automated, what it saved you, and where it got things wrong. - Comfortable working with several hiring managers at once, with different standards and different budgets. **Helpful** - Sourcing experience in African markets. - A technical background of any depth, even informal. - Experience recruiting for an organization that was not the highest bidder, or not yet well known in its market. **How we work** - Async-first, fully remote. Work from wherever you are, on hours that fit your timezone. - 22-person team with minimal hierarchy and short feedback loops. - You will be the first person in this role, sitting in Operations and working closely with our 7-person tech team on hiring. - You will work alongside people who came from Google, Meta, Zepto, Spacelift and Atlas AI. **Location** - Remote, based in India.
